scope: Harvest D D4 and D3-Closure local Ollama testing on the current test machine

system_only.rule: Use while decision-relevant; bounded by ordinary runtime usefulness, not model-call quota.

residency_prior.reason: The current local hardware exhibits a sharp practical cost increase when the installed model/runtime footprint crosses roughly 9.5 GiB. Treat the cliff as a strong scheduling prior and verify it with runtime calibration.

tiny_model_prior.rule: Permit very broad development sampling when runtime calibration confirms negligible latency relative to larger models.

FREE.sampling_policy: No physical model-call ceiling; use all useful deterministic/system-only analysis.

NEAR_FREE.sampling_policy: Highest live-model sample allowance; hundreds or more calls are acceptable when scientifically useful.

MEDIUM.sampling_policy: Moderate sample allowance; broad enough for model-specific discovery when evidence value is high.

VERY_EXPENSIVE.sampling_policy: Small selective sample allowance; use only for boundary localization, strongest challengers, and required confirmation unless calibration proves otherwise.

classification_precedence: explicit tiny-model prior + confirmed negligible latency => NEAR_FREE
installed artifact/residency footprint > 9.5 GiB => VERY_EXPENSIVE prior
installed artifact/residency footprint <= 9.5 GiB => MEDIUM_OR_CHEAPER prior
thinking/near-context-exhaustion may raise the cost class
measured stable low latency may lower a prior only after calibration evidence
observed offload/spill or severe latency raises the cost class immediately
budget_rule: Scientific depth is allocated by information value per calibrated inference cost. Fast/cheap models get more trials; slow/large/offloaded models get fewer; system-only work is free.
